A tiny tortoise evolves step by step into a sacred beast, its back vast as ten thousand miles, bearing mountains, rivers, and fertile soil—luciel's future homeland.
A fragile sapling grows into a towering World Tree, shielding against acid rain, calming storms, and restoring blue skies and white clouds.
A single military ant becomes the progenitor of an unstoppable Ant Legion, a living sandstorm that leaves only bones in its wake.
Even the rabbit-eared girl who rescued him… somehow gets tangled up in his fate.
With each creature tamed, Luciel reshapes the wasteland.
